models_evaluated: twelve LLMs in total (others not named in text)

links.outcome: Whether verbatim source quotes attached to LLM claims fully substantiate those claims
links.effect: Most models attach verbatim quotes to over 90% of claims, but quotes often fail to fully substantiate them; claude-opus-5 gives quotes for 98.0% of claims but fully substantiates only 37.1%.
links.quote: For instance, claude-opus-5 produces verbatim quotes for 98.0% of its claims, but fully substantiates only 37.1%.

unlisted_practices: Claim-level verbatim quote citation (verifiable-by-construction) for clinical question answering, evaluated stage by stage

screen.reason: Empirically benchmarks LLMs on a clinical question-answering task to evaluate the deployment safeguard of making answers verifiable by construction via fine-grained verbatim quotes from guidelines.
